'''''Froond''-class Hyperdrives''' were powerful [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] systems manufactured on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]]. They were built outside the sphere of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and so were not classed in the standard rating system.
